You will be responsible for leading the design and implementation of scalable software solutions, mentoring engineers, driving technical excellence, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
In addition to being a strong individual contributor, you will provide day-to-day technical leadership, facilitate architectural discussions, conduct design and code reviews, establish engineering standards, and guide the team's adoption of modern development practices. OnVUE is Pearson VUE's remote proctoring platform, enabling candidates to take high-stakes exams securely from anywhere in the world. The product remains a strategic investment area for Pearson VUE and continues to grow in scale, functionality, and complexity.

Technical Leadership
Lead and mentor software engineers across one or more development squads.
Provide technical direction and coaching to team members.
Establish and promote engineering best practices.
Drive code quality, maintainability, security, and performance standards.
Lead technical design sessions and architectural discussions.
Collaborate with Product Architects to ensure alignment with platform strategy.
Software Development
Design, develop, and deliver enterprise-scale software solutions.
Develop new features and technical enhancements across the OnVUE platform.
Create scalable and maintainable system designs.
Participate in complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.
Support release planning and deployment activities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Product Managers and Business Analysts to refine requirements.
Work closely with Quality Engineering to improve quality and automation.
Coordinate with DevOps and Infrastructure teams on cloud-native solutions.
Contribute to roadmap planning and technical estimation activities.
Support platform modernization and technical debt reduction initiatives.

Demonstrated technical leadership with a strong focus on engineering quality and continuous improvement.
Strong software design and system architecture skills.
Experience with cloud-based DevOps workflows and CI/CD environments.
Experience building highly available and scalable enterprise applications.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience mentoring developers and building high-performing engineering teams.
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and machine learning concepts is preferred.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable platforms is preferred.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software development experience.
3+ years of technical leadership or lead developer experience.
